1722-2034-3583-6559.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6559.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

969-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
969-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3875-3897.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3875-3897.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

7675-7676-8101.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Wooded Foothills.
7675-7676-8101.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Wooded Foothills.
When Wooded Foothills enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Wooded Foothills by paying 1 life, tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1978-3139-5793-7008.description:
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding two mana and gaining 2 life.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Great Henge which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Great Henge.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3088-3899-4552-7824.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1887-4636-5770-7824.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating two 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-5361-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5361-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5361-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1169-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1169-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1169-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7727.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4331-4993-5116-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
4331-4993-5116-7693.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

628-997-5007.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.
628-997-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

423-1437-5478-5621.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-5478-5621.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, drawing a card then putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
In response, activate the land by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-5478-5621.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Spelunking. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

240-1115-3967-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

141-997-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

4605-5256-6132-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3678-5686-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-5686-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

1456-2466-5051-5078.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Traxos, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3234-3293-4050-5226.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4050-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-4050-5226.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1651-2073-6757-6798--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
1651-2073-6757-6798--90.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions to get infinite damage if desired. If the noncreature artifact chosen can sacrifice itself without tapping or additional costs, you can omit the sacrifice outlet, but will forego the possibility of infinite damage.

944-2921-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
944-2921-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
944-2921-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

643-1429-5402-5686.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-5402-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2523-3967-5559.description:
Cast Nazgûl by paying {2}{B}.
Nazgûl enters, triggering its first activated ability, causing the Ring to tempt you; choose Nazgûl as your Ring-bearer, making it legendary.
Nazgûl's second activated ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nazgûl.
Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Nazgûl that's a 2/2 Zombie.
Resolve the ability from step 4, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5695-5752.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brokkos, adding {1}.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Saprolings, adding {1}{U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

2092-2816-4315.notablePrerequisites: Umbral Mantle and Careful Cultivation attached to the same creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
2092-2816-4315.description:
Activate the creature with Careful Cultivation and Umbral Mantle attached by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate the creature by paying at most {2} and untapping it, causing it to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
If Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater, this combo nets infinite green mana.

1462-1874-2232-2413-2768.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 8.
You control at least four nontoken creatures.
You have not cast a spell using Demon of Fate's Design's ability this turn.
1462-1874-2232-2413-2768.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying 7 life due to Demon of Fate's Design.
When Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, exiling all creatures you control and creating that many 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
When the Dragon(s) enter the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome and Cloudstone Curio trigger that many times.
Resolve all Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each Dragon that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all but one Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the final Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Day of the Dragons to your hand from the battlefield.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return all cards exiled with Day of the Dragons to the battlefield.
 When Demon of Fate's Design and any other creature(s) that were exiled by Day of the Dragons enter the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome and Cloudstone Curio trigger that many times.
Resolve all Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each creature that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

942-1082-4050.description:
Cast Samwise the Stouthearted by paying {1}{W}.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters the battlefield, it and Dual Nature's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Samwise the Stouthearted trigger, returning nothing to your hand from your graveyard, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Samwise, adding {1}.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling all Samwise the Stouthearted tokens on the battlefield.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Samwise the Stouthearted to your hand from your graveyard, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Samwise the Stouthearted token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1651-4330-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has fought this turn.
1651-4330-4365.description:
Activate Boxing Ring by tapping it, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Boxing Ring.
Repeat.

430-1061-3106.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
430-1061-3106.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Grismold triggers, causing each player to create a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

413-914-3352.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
413-914-3352.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Disturbed Burial for its buyback cost by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist for {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of artifacts and enchantments your opponent control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate seven of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{R}.
Repeat.

132-2645-4087.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Lavabrink Floodgates's ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2645-4087.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.
